consolidate_checkpoints: consolidate FSDP distributed checkpoints in a directory into a single consolidated.pth file
CheckpointManager_save: save model, optimizer, and train state to a checkpoint folder using CheckpointManager
CheckpointManager_load: load model, optimizer, and train state from a checkpoint folder using CheckpointManager
CheckpointManager_clean_up: clean up old checkpoint folders keeping only the most recent dump and eval saves
CheckpointManager_get_existing_saves: get a sorted list of existing checkpoint save folders from the checkpoint directory
